label: Energy (US Atwater factors)
meaning: Energy from protein, fat and carbohydrate (by difference) with Atwater food-specific factors; for multi-ingredient processed foods, industry factors 4/4/9

label: Energy (UK factors)
meaning: Energy from protein 4, fat 9, available carbohydrate as monosaccharide equivalents 3.75 and alcohol 7 kcal/g; no energy from fibre (the UK convention; not the EU labelling factors)

label: Energy (EU labelling factors)
meaning: Energy with the EU labelling factors (Regulation 1169/2011, Annex XIV): protein 4, fat 9, carbohydrate by weight 4, fibre 2 kcal/g; calculated from blended parts. Polyols and organic acids are counted as carbohydrate (4, not 2.4 or 3); foods with alcohol aren't calculated

label: Protein
meaning: Total nitrogen x a food-specific conversion factor (6.25 unless stated); non-protein nitrogen removed for mushrooms

label: Fat
meaning: Total fat (all lipid components extracted), not only triglycerides

label: Fat (US label definition)
meaning: Total fatty acids expressed as triglycerides (US label fat)

label: Saturated fat
meaning: Total saturated fatty acids per 100 g food

label: Carbohydrate (by difference, without fibre)
meaning: Available carbohydrate by difference: 100 minus water, protein, fat, ash, alcohol and total dietary fibre

label: Carbohydrate (by difference, with fibre)
meaning: Carbohydrate by difference, including fibre (used where the food has no fibre value)

label: Carbohydrate (available, as monosaccharides)
meaning: Available carbohydrate as the sum of analysed starch, sugars and oligosaccharides, in monosaccharide equivalents (about 5-10% above weight for starch and disaccharides)

label: Fibre (AOAC)
meaning: Total dietary fibre by AOAC enzymatic-gravimetric methods (includes resistant starch and lignin)

label: Sugars (by weight)
meaning: Total free mono- and disaccharides, by weight

label: Sugars (as monosaccharides)
meaning: Total free mono- and disaccharides in monosaccharide equivalents (disaccharides counted about 5% heavier)

label: Calcium
meaning: Calcium

label: Iron
meaning: Iron

label: Magnesium
meaning: Magnesium

label: Phosphorus
meaning: Phosphorus

label: Potassium
meaning: Potassium

label: Sodium
meaning: Sodium

label: Zinc
meaning: Zinc

label: Copper
meaning: Copper

label: Manganese
meaning: Manganese

label: Selenium
meaning: Selenium

label: Iodine
meaning: Iodine

label: Vitamin A (retinol activity equivalents)
meaning: Retinol activity equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene/12 + other provitamin A carotenoids/24 (IOM 2001)

label: Vitamin A (retinol equivalents)
meaning: Retinol equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene/6 + other provitamin A carotenoids/12

label: Retinol
meaning: Retinol (all-trans-retinol equivalent)

label: Vitamin D (D2 + D3)
meaning: Vitamin D2 + D3 (no 25-hydroxy vitamin D)

label: Vitamin D (including 25-hydroxy D3)
meaning: Vitamin D3 + 5 x 25-hydroxy vitamin D3 (vitamin D activity, meat)

label: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol)
meaning: Alpha-tocopherol only

label: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol equivalents)
meaning: Alpha-tocopherol equivalents (other tocopherols and tocotrienols weighted by activity)

label: Vitamin K1
meaning: Phylloquinone (vitamin K1)

label: Vitamin C
meaning: Total vitamin C: ascorbic acid + dehydroascorbic acid

label: Thiamin
meaning: Thiamin. CoFID expresses it as thiamine chloride hydrochloride; USDA doesn't state the form (combined on a data check: caveat salt-basis-thiamin)

label: Riboflavin
meaning: Riboflavin

label: Niacin (preformed)
meaning: Preformed niacin (nicotinic acid + nicotinamide)

label: Niacin equivalents
meaning: Niacin equivalents: preformed niacin + tryptophan/60

label: Pantothenic acid
meaning: Pantothenic acid. CoFID expresses it as calcium D-pantothenate; USDA doesn't state the form (combined on a data check: caveat salt-basis-pantothenic)

label: Vitamin B6
meaning: Vitamin B6. CoFID expresses it as pyridoxine hydrochloride; USDA doesn't state the form (combined on a data check: caveat salt-basis-vitaminB6)

label: Folate (total)
meaning: Total folate (food folate + any folic acid), by weight

label: Folate (dietary folate equivalents)
meaning: Dietary folate equivalents: food folate + 1.7 x folic acid

label: Vitamin B12
meaning: Vitamin B12

label: Choline
meaning: Total choline

label: Linoleic acid
meaning: Linoleic acid: cis,cis n-6 C18:2, per 100 g food

label: C18:2 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
meaning: C18:2, isomers not separated (includes trans and other forms), per 100 g food

label: Alpha-linolenic acid
meaning: Alpha-linolenic acid: cis n-3 C18:3, per 100 g food

label: C18:3 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
meaning: C18:3, isomers not separated (includes gamma-linolenic acid), per 100 g food

label: EPA
meaning: EPA: n-3 C20:5, per 100 g food

label: C20:5 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
meaning: C20:5, isomers not separated, per 100 g food

label: DHA
meaning: DHA: n-3 C22:6, per 100 g food

label: C22:6 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
meaning: C22:6, isomers not separated, per 100 g food
